data.name: SqlSelectCommand1.CommandText
data.value: SELECT tblQuoteOptions.QuoteOptionGUID, tblQuoteOptions.QuoteGUID, tblQuoteOptions.LineGUID, tblQuoteOptions.Premium, tblQuoteOptions.DateCreated, tblQuoteOptions.QuoteOptionID, tblQuoteOptions.AdditionalComments, tblQuoteOptions.CompanyLocationID, COALESCE (tblCompanyLocations.Name, tblCompanyLocations_1.Name) AS CompanyLocation FROM tblQuoteOptions INNER JOIN tblQuotes ON tblQuoteOptions.QuoteGUID = tblQuotes.QuoteGUID INNER JOIN tblCompanyLocations tblCompanyLocations_1 ON tblQuotes.CompanyLocationGuid = tblCompanyLocations_1.CompanyLocationGUID LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCompanyLocations ON tblQuoteOptions.CompanyLocationID = tblCompanyLocations.CompanyLocationCode WHERE (tblQuoteOptions.QuoteGUID = @QuoteGUID) AND (tblQuoteOptions.LineGUID = @LineGUID)

data.name: SqlSelectCommand2.CommandText
data.value: SELECT dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.GenericID, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.QuoteOptionGuid, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.EffectiveDate, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.Factor, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.UserOverrideFactor, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.ChargeCode, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.OfficeID, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.Premium, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.Added, dbo.tblFin_PolicyCharges.StateID, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.EndorsementCalcType, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.RoundToDollar, dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.CurrentAnnualPremium, ISNULL(dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.IncludeLeapYear, 0) AS IncludeLeapYear FROM dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric INNER JOIN dbo.tblQuoteOptions ON dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.QuoteOptionGuid = dbo.tblQuoteOptions.QuoteOptionGUID INNER JOIN dbo.tblFin_PolicyCharges ON dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric.ChargeCode = dbo.tblFin_PolicyCharges.ChargeCode WHERE (dbo.tblQuoteOptions.QuoteGUID = @QuoteGuid) AND (dbo.tblQuoteOptions.LineGUID = @LineGuid)

data.name: SqlUpdateCommand3.CommandText
data.value: UPDATE dbo.tblGenericLimits SET QuoteID = @QuoteID, Limit = @Limit, SubLimits = @SubLimits, Perils = @Perils, Covering = @Covering, Deductible = @Deductible, Valuation = @Valuation, Excluding = @Excluding, AdditionalComments = @AdditionalComments,PolicyLimit=@PolicyLimit WHERE (QuoteID = @Original_QuoteID)

data.name: SqlUpdateCommand1.CommandText
data.value: UPDATE tblQuoteOptions SET QuoteOptionGUID = @QuoteOptionGUID, QuoteGUID = @QuoteGUID, LineGUID = @LineGUID, DateCreated = @DateCreated, AdditionalComments = @AdditionalComments, CompanyLocationID = @CompanyLocationID WHERE (QuoteOptionGUID = @Original_QuoteOptionGUID); SELECT QuoteOptionGUID, QuoteGUID, LineGUID, Premium, DateCreated, QuoteOptionID, AdditionalComments, CompanyLocationID FROM tblQuoteOptions WHERE (QuoteOptionGUID = @QuoteOptionGUID)

data.name: SqlUpdateCommand2.CommandText
data.value: UPDATE dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric SET QuoteOptionGuid = @QuoteOptionGuid, EffectiveDate = @EffectiveDate, UserOverrideFactor = @UserOverrideFactor, ChargeCode = @ChargeCode, OfficeID = @OfficeID, Premium = @Premium, Added = @Added, EndorsementCalcType = @EndorsementCalcType, RoundToDollar = @RoundToDollar, CurrentAnnualPremium = @CurrentAnnualPremium, IncludeLeapYear = @IncludeLeapYear WHERE (GenericID = @Original_GenericID); SELECT GenericID, QuoteOptionGuid, EffectiveDate, UserOverrideFactor, ChargeCode, OfficeID, Premium, Added, EndorsementCalcType, RoundToDollar, IncludeLeapYear FROM tblQuoteOptionGeneric WHERE (GenericID = @GenericID)

data.name: SqlInsertCommand3.CommandText
data.value: INSERT INTO dbo.tblGenericLimits(QuoteID, Limit, SubLimits, Perils, Covering, Deductible, Valuation, Excluding, AdditionalComments,PolicyLimit) VALUES (@QuoteID, @Limit, @SubLimits, @Perils, @Covering, @Deductible, @Valuation, @Excluding, @AdditionalComments,@PolicyLimit)

data.name: SqlInsertCommand2.CommandText
data.value: INSERT INTO dbo.tblQuoteOptionGeneric (QuoteOptionGuid, EffectiveDate, UserOverrideFactor, ChargeCode, OfficeID, Premium, Added, EndorsementCalcType, RoundToDollar, CurrentAnnualPremium, IncludeLeapYear) VALUES (@QuoteOptionGuid,@EffectiveDate,@UserOverrideFactor,@ChargeCode,@OfficeID,@Premium,@Added,@EndorsementCalcType,@RoundToDollar,@CurrentAnnualPremium, @IncludeLeapYear); SELECT GenericID, QuoteOptionGuid, EffectiveDate, UserOverrideFactor, ChargeCode, OfficeID, Premium, Added, EndorsementCalcType, RoundToDollar, IncludeLeapYear FROM tblQuoteOptionGeneric WHERE (GenericID = SCOPE_IDENTITY())

data.name: SqlInsertCommand1.CommandText
data.value: INSERT INTO tblQuoteOptions(QuoteOptionGUID, QuoteGUID, LineGUID, DateCreated, AdditionalComments, CompanyLocationID) VALUES (@QuoteOptionGUID, @QuoteGUID, @LineGUID, @DateCreated, @AdditionalComments, @CompanyLocationID); SELECT QuoteOptionGUID, QuoteGUID, LineGUID, Premium, DateCreated, QuoteOptionID, AdditionalComments, CompanyLocationID FROM tblQuoteOptions WHERE (QuoteOptionGUID = @QuoteOptionGUID)
